summary.text: Golden Fur Immortal Monarch is a hairy man Gu Immortal who arrives at Ice Crystal grotto-heaven among rank eight variant human experts.

claims.text: Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch holds a second meeting after Wu Shuai urges him to gather remaining grotto-heaven forces. Golden Fur Immortal Monarch arrives with Blitz Cloud Heavenly Immortal, Great Wisdom Immortal Mother, and Green Forest Great Sage. This is the first time these four have attended. Wu Shuai sits on the main seat and tells the immortals to call him alliance leader. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch greets him as such and is named vice alliance leader. The others acknowledge Wu Shuai.
He is a hairy man, covered in thick golden fur.

Unable to endure Fang Yuan’s pressure, he is the first alliance member to agree, offering his immortal aperture. He is a rank eight hairy man Gu Immortal. He knows Fang Yuan annexed Lang Ya blessed land and rarely sent Lang Ya Sect’s hairy man Gu Immortals into battle, and he surrenders thinking he will receive similar treatment. Hairy men are proficient in Gu refinement, which might preserve the people of Golden Fur grotto-heaven and even give them high statuses, rather than being slaughtered and forcefully annexed. His agreement puts pressure on the rest.
Related site detail sits on Golden Fur grotto-heaven.
After the Eastern Sea victory he kneels before Fang Yuan and offers Golden Fur grotto-heaven. The rest of the variant human alliance then pledges allegiance.
In the same cleanup of grotto-heavens after that victory, Fang Yuan annexes three rank eight sites on heaven vein nodes, including rule path Novelty grotto-heaven.
Related site detail sits on Novelty Grotto-Heaven.

At Fire Plain grotto-heaven the hairy man Gu Immortals are slightly weaker, because they mostly cultivate refinement path. He is one of the exceptions in that fight. He is covered in golden thread-like fur as he holds a hammer and charges forward with ferocious might, raising morale. Golden Hair grotto-heaven and Strange Hair grotto-heaven have been annexed by Fang Yuan into the sovereign immortal aperture.

He goes to Human Smoke Mountain with Bing Yuan and Shi Zong as snowman, hairy man, and rockman, all at rank eight. Bing Yuan leads and speaks for the trade. Chai clan’s first supreme elder Chai Gan asks what Fang Yuan wants; Bing Yuan names human path results, including congregated human talent, Human Smoke Mountain, and many mortals the clan raises. When Chai Gan asks what Fang Yuan wants the mortals for, Shi Zong sneers that they will kill them all. Golden Fur Immortal Monarch has a crazed expression: those humans have abundant human qi, and Fang Yuan’s Human Sea needs only a final step. Chai Ke Qing, a Chai clan female immortal, shouts that the demon deserves death for disregarding lives so casually.

After Chai Ke Qing curses Fang Yuan, Shi Zong calls the remark impudent. Golden Fur Immortal Monarch takes out two large hammers with surging killing intent and says the three of them will attack and exterminate Chai clan without reporting to their master. Bing Yuan stops the fight. She was the last of the three to advance to rank eight, passing her tribulation with Fang Yuan’s help. He and Shi Zong accept her leadership because she is Xue Er’s grandmother. He reluctantly puts away his hammers while staring at the Chai immortals. Chai Gan apologizes for his clansman’s careless remark, then argues that selling the clan foundation is like asking Heavenly Court to sell fate Gu, and that buying a super force’s foundation out of nowhere has no such logic. Golden Fur Immortal Monarch snickers that if Chai clan wants to keep its foundation, it can surrender to Fang Yuan.

When Chai Ke Qing calls the Wu Yong cooperation claim a lie, Golden Fur Immortal Monarch laughs that she is wrong, and Shi Zong adds that Wu Yong has already traded with them several times. As Chai clan tilts toward cooperating, Chai Gan seals Chai Ke Qing so she cannot budge, then orders Chai Dui Shan to control his own descendant and strengthen the seal; the three variant humans cannot even sense the seal’s path aura. Under the later agreement Chai clan sells Human Smoke Mountain and most mortals there, keeping clansmen and a show of outsiders; the three variant humans dig up the mountain, slaughter countless mortals, take human path results, and leave a fire path true inheritance plus three rank eight Immortal Gu. After the trade Golden Fur Immortal Monarch shows disdain that three rank eight Immortal Gu were enough to move a Southern Border super clan. He flatters Bing Yuan for saving two rank eight Immortal Gu. When she mentions Xue Er again, he and Shi Zong look at each other, nauseated and envious. He guesses Fang Yuan traded with Wu clan, Chai clan, and Fang clan because he wants to convert to righteous path. He adds that even then their lives would be good, and that as a hairy man he finally tastes equality while watching Chai clan Gu Immortals hold back their anger. He pats his chest that they follow Fang Yuan’s decision.

At Green Lotus Great World, he holds two large hammers and attacks aggressively, covered in thick golden fur, with many Immortal Gu and killer moves and tight defense, so he charges without worry. He disrupts the formation of Heavenly Court’s mutant Gu Immortals. Grass Head Child, a child-like wood path Gu Immortal with grass on his head, blocks him. After lingering poisonous ant plague hits Grass Head Child, he chases and smashes him into pulp with his hammer.
